description: Serves the plan v7 section 8.3 expression clause for operator precedence, parenthesized override, short-circuit evaluation, and the two behaviors that surround an expression: what a throwing expression does to the alternative scan, and that the SECOND expression site (generated-placeholder fragment expressions, compiled by DefaultStrings.compileExpressions and evaluated by resolveExpressionTranslation) obeys the same rules. Every expression here is statically valid so the fixture constructs -- lokalized-java validates alternative expressions three times before any case runs (LocalizedStringLoader at load, LocalizedStringValidator via DefaultStrings.validateLocalizedString, and ExpressionEvaluator.compile in the constructor), and a single invalid expression aborts the whole corpus run, so discrimination has to come from which branch's translation is emitted and from whether an unbound right-hand operand is ever reached. Each key's default translation is the literal string 'no alternative' so a non-match is distinguishable from a match and from a resolution failure. Only 'en' is loaded, so there is no same-language ambiguity and tiebreakers is null.

Expr.Precedence.AndBindsTighterThanOr.commentary: Correct parse is alpha || (beta && gamma). A parse of (alpha || beta) && gamma emits 'no alternative' for the same inputs.

Expr.Precedence.ParenthesesOverrideAndBi.commentary: Same operands as Expr.Precedence.AndBindsTighterThanOr, parenthesized the other way, so the same tuple must invert.

Expr.Precedence.OrShortCircuitsAndBranch.commentary: alpha || (absentLeft && absentRight). Neither absent placeholder may be touched when alpha matches.

Expr.Precedence.AndBranchShortCircuitsBe.commentary: (alpha && absentRight) || beta. The and-branch must short-circuit to false and the or-branch must still be evaluated.

Expr.ShortCircuit.LeftOperandAlwaysEvalu.commentary: The left operand is unconditionally evaluated even when the right operand alone would settle the result.

Expr.ShortCircuit.OrSkipsIllTypedRight.commentary: The skipped right operand fails on operand TYPE rather than on a missing binding.

Expr.Alternative.EarlierAlternativeFailu.commentary: Alternative 0 can never be evaluated; alternative 1 would match. A throw in an earlier alternative must abort the key rather than fall through.

Expr.Alternative.LaterAlternativeIsReach.commentary: Control shape for the abort key: both alternatives are always evaluable, so array order and fall-through are observable on their own.

Expr.Fragment.PrecedenceAndBindsTighterT.commentary: Second expression site: a generated-placeholder fragment expression, compiled and evaluated by resolveExpressionTranslation rather than alternativeMatches.

Expr.Fragment.OrShortCircuitsAbsentOpera.commentary: Short-circuiting at the fragment expression site.
